verdict.rationale: Gazebo is open-source software installable and runnable entirely on one's own infrastructure, including headless server-only mode, remote server operation via TCP/IP transport, and a lightweight server-only package without GUI/Qt dependencies. missing for 10: no explicit first-party 'self-hosting guide' or containerized/cloud-deployment reference architecture, and no independent hands-on corroboration of a full self-hosted deployment.
